label: Controls for the typed LORD_2 and BLESSED_2 readings
paraphrase: Closed controls on interpretations with two beings (Bool; only true is GOD_4 and has intellect), one end and no potency: (1) nonvacuity: the directing bridge and the q.103 a.3 reading hold, and true has the nine, LORD_2 and BLESSED_2; (2) only true causes, nothing governs, nothing is LORD_1: 'Whatever is LORD_2 is LORD_1' holds and 'Whatever causes the being of everything else is LORD_1 of everything else' fails; (3) with a respect of understanding in which nothing is in act and nothing BLESSED_1: 'Whatever is BLESSED_2 is BLESSED_1' holds and 'Whatever is PERFECT_2 and HAS_INTELLECT_1 is BLESSED_1' fails; (4) nothing directs or governs: the q.103 a.3 reading holds, true has the nine and is not LORD_2; (5) nothing is in act in understanding: true has the nine and is not BLESSED_2; (6) sense mixing: with nothing LORD_1 or BLESSED_1, true has the nine and is LORD_2 and BLESSED_2. Statements about these interpretations only.
